address: 36 rue de la Rollandie, Saint-Flour, 15100, France
bio: In the heart of Saint-Flour, a medieval village built of volcanic stone, this restaurant was opened by a local couple at just the right time! The concise set menu, with its three options (including a starter and a vegetarian dish) doesn't disappoint: everything served here is cooked from scratch. The simple menu with an eye for the zeitgeist favours local ingredients (while sometimes casting the net wider), such as lentilles blondes de Saint-Flour, which the chef prepares chilli style, adding a slow-cooked egg and a corn espuma. In fact, the chef has become a specialist in this particular lentil!...
